en-GB.title: Trade Tender
en-GB.subtitle: Quotes for site buying
en-GB.description:
Trade Tender is for UK construction Buyers and Suppliers. Set out a job, compare quotes on the same brief, and award the work. Names and phone numbers stay private until a site visit is booked or you accept a quote.

FOR BUYERS
• Create a tender with trade, quantity, location, and deadline
• Matched Suppliers quote the same written brief
• Compare price, lead time, and documents in one place
• Accept a quote with a purchase order number

FOR SUPPLIERS
• See jobs that match your services and area
• Unlock a tender, ask questions, and submit a quote
• For contractor and professional jobs, pay a fixed fee to contact the Buyer for a site visit

PAYMENTS AND PRIVACY
Unlock and contact-release payments run through Stripe. The app stores your session on the device in the OS keystore, not in ordinary files. Trade Tender is not a party to the final contract.

Support and the privacy policy are on the Trade Tender website.
en-GB.releaseNotes: First App Store release of the Trade Tender Buyer and Supplier workspace.

review.notes: Sign-in is required. Provide App Review with a verified Buyer account and a verified Supplier account before submission. Do not place live passwords in this file. The app talks to https://trade-tender.onrender.com. Stripe Checkout may open for unlock or contact-release payments. Owner and Super User consoles are web-only.
